transitions.name: Accordion

pleats.description: Number of pleats in each image (a pleat is a pair of panels, one lit and one in the shade)

direction.description: Direction in which the images move, snapped to its main axis (left, right, up or down): the outgoing image folds up toward it, the incoming one unfolds from the opposite side

shading.description: Contrast between the lit and the shaded panels

perspective.description: Amount of perspective: the valleys between the pleats recede

backColor.description: Color seen around the folded images, where the valleys recede

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image folds up like a pleated paper toward one side while the incoming one unfolds out of the other, both in 3D with lit and shadowed pleats

transitions.name: ApertureWipe

rotation.description: How much the blades turn while opening, in degrees

shadow.description: How dark the blades are shaded along their edges

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A camera aperture opens its turning blades to reveal the incoming image

transitions.name: ArrowWipe

direction.description: Direction the arrow points and flies toward

notch.description: Depth of the notch at the back of the arrowhead (0 for a plain triangle)

width.description: Opening angle of the arrowhead's tip, in degrees

count.description: Number of nested chevrons flying in a row

origin.description: Grow the arrow from the center of the frame instead of flying it in

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A notched arrowhead window onto the incoming image flies in from the edge behind it (or appears at the center), then swells until it fills the frame

transitions.name: Ascii

cellSize.description: Height of a character, in frame heights

colored.description: Color the characters with the image (otherwise, with the ink color)

ink.description: Color of the characters when they are not colored with the image

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The image turns into text-mode characters, denser where it is brighter, the characters scramble into those of the incoming image, then resolve back into it

transitions.name: BandWipe

vertical.description: Cut the frame into columns that wipe up and down instead of rows that wipe sideways

smoothness.description: Softness of the bands' leading edges

stagger.description: Delay between the first and the last band, so they cascade from the top (or the left)

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Alternating bands wipe in from opposite sides together and interleave like fingers, while both images stay still

transitions.name: BlockCover

blocks.description: Number of blocks along the longer side of the frame (the blocks stay about square)

pop.description: How much a block overshoots its cell as it pops in

smoothness.description: Softness of the blocks' edges, in blocks

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Blocks of a solid color pop in at random over the outgoing image until they cover the frame, then pop out in another random order to show the incoming image

transitions.name: BlockSlide

grid.description: Number of blocks (columns, rows), at most 40 along the direction

direction.description: Direction the blocks slide toward (rounded to the nearest axis)

stagger.description: Share of the transition over which the blocks set off one after another (0 slides them all together)

zoom.description: How much the zooming blocks shrink on their way, as a share of their size

background.description: Color seen in the gaps between the blocks

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The frame is cut into a grid of blocks that slide out one after another in a staggered cascade, some of them shrinking as they go, while the blocks of the incoming image slide in behind them to take their place

transitions.name: BloomDissolve

spread.description: Reach of the glow at the peak, in frame heights

threshold.description: Brightness above which the image glows (the whole frame does at the peak)

tint.description: Tint of the glow, toward its edges

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The highlights of the outgoing image blow out into a soft, wide glow that floods the frame; under it the incoming image takes over, then the glow subsides back into its highlights while the image stays sharp

transitions.name: BokehDissolve

radius.description: Radius of the bokeh discs at the peak, in frame heights

blades.description: Number of aperture blades, which shape the discs into polygons (below 3: round)

threshold.description: Brightness above which a pixel is a highlight that swells into a disc

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The image falls out of focus like a camera lens, its highlights swelling into large bright bokeh discs, and the incoming image sharpens back out of its own bokeh

transitions.name: BookFlip

perspective.description: Strength of the perspective: the page grows as it lifts toward the viewer

shading.description: How much the page darkens as it turns away from the light, and the shadows it casts

curl.description: How much the page bends near its free edge, which trails behind as it turns

transitions.author: hong
transitions.description: The right half of the outgoing image is a book page that turns over from right to left on the spine at the middle of the frame, curling near its free edge, its back bringing the left half of the incoming image

transitions.name: Bounce

shadow_colour.description: Color of the shadow cast on the incoming image

shadow_height.description: Height of the shadow, relative to the image height

transitions.author: Adrian Purser
transitions.description: The outgoing image drops out of the frame with a few bounces, revealing the incoming one

transitions.name: BowTie
transitions.author: KMojek
transitions.description: Two triangles grow from the top and bottom edges into a bow tie that reveals the incoming image, with an adjustable shape, and can run in reverse

transitions.name: BowTieHorizontal
transitions.author: huynx
transitions.description: Two triangles grow from the left and right edges into a bow tie that reveals the incoming image

transitions.name: BrushWipe

strokes.description: Number of brush strokes needed to cover the frame

angle.description: Angle of the strokes, in degrees

roughness.description: How rough the bristles make the edges and ends of the strokes

waviness.description: How much the strokes wave along their way

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A few broad brush strokes sweep across the frame in turn, back and forth, painting in the incoming image with streaky bristle edges and dry, ragged ends

transitions.name: BurnThrough
transitions.author: liubailin2020@gmail.com
transitions.description: The outgoing image burns away in noisy, glowing patches

transitions.name: ButterflyWaveScrawler
transitions.author: mandubian
transitions.description: Wavy, color-separated ripples scramble the outgoing image into the incoming one

transitions.name: CameraShake

strength.description: How far the camera jolts (and rolls) at the peak of the shake

jolts.description: Number of jolts over the transition

blur.description: Length of the motion blur along each jolt

split.description: How far the color channels split apart along each jolt

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The camera jolts violently in random directions, with motion blur and color fringes along each jolt; the cut happens at the peak of the shake, which then settles on the incoming image

transitions.name: CardSwipe

direction.description: Direction in which the outgoing card is flicked

rotation.description: How much the outgoing card swings as it flies out

depth.description: How much smaller the incoming card starts

backColor.description: Color seen around the incoming card while it is smaller than the frame

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image is flicked off like the top card of a stack, swinging around a point below it as it flies out, while the incoming card behind it grows to fill the frame

transitions.name: CellDissolve

cells.description: Number of cells across the height of the frame

smoothness.description: Duration of each cell's switch, as a fraction of the transition (0: each cell switches at once)

border.description: Width of the border along the cell edges, in frame heights (0: no border)

seed.description: Random seed: another value gives other cells, switching in another order

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Irregular cells, like cracked mud or soap foam, switch to the incoming image one by one, with an optional bright border glowing along the cracks between them

transitions.name: Chessboard
transitions.author: lql
transitions.description: A chessboard pattern of squares reveals the incoming image

transitions.name: CircleBurst

center.description: Point the discs burst out of, in texture coordinates

color3.description: Color of the third disc, which opens onto the incoming image

stagger.description: Delay between the discs, relative to the burst of one disc (at 0, they burst as one: a single circle opens onto the incoming image)

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Discs of three solid colors burst out of a point one after another, each covering the last, then a hole bursts open from the same point in the last one to reveal the incoming image

transitions.name: CircleIris
transitions.author: Fernando Kuteken
transitions.description: The outgoing image closes into a circle over a background color, then the incoming one opens from it

transitions.name: CircleOpen

opening.description: Open the circle; false closes it instead

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A soft-edged circle opens from the center to reveal the incoming image

transitions.name: ClockWipe

startingAngle.description: Angle where the wipe starts, in degrees

transitions.author: Fernando Kuteken
transitions.description: A wipe that sweeps around the center from a starting angle

transitions.name: Clothesline

direction.description: Way the line is pulled: 1 brings the incoming print in from the right, -1 from the left

sway.description: How much the prints swing and tilt as the line moves

size.description: Size of the prints when the camera is farthest, as a part of the frame

background.description: Color of the wall behind the line

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The camera pulls back to show the outgoing image as a print hung by two clothespins on a line in front of a wall, the line is pulled sideways and carries it away while the incoming print slides in, both prints swinging and tilting like hanging paper, then the camera moves back in on the incoming print until it fills the frame

transitions.name: CodeRain

cellSize.description: Height of a character, in frame heights

trail.description: Average length of the streams' fading tails, in frame heights

tint.description: How much the characters of the outgoing image take its colors, instead of the glow color

glow.description: Color of the falling streams and their glow

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image darkens into a grid of flickering code characters tinted by its colors, then glowing streams of characters fall down the columns at their own speeds, each with a bright head and a fading tail, leaving the incoming image behind

transitions.name: ColorCoords
transitions.author: haiyoucuv
transitions.description: A crossfade in which the colors of one image displace the other

transitions.name: ColorDistance
transitions.author: P-Seebauer
transitions.description: Pixels switch to the incoming image in order of how close their colors are

transitions.name: ColorPanelWipe

direction.description: Direction the panels sweep toward

stagger.description: Delay between the panels, relative to the sweep of one panel (at 0, they move as one and only the last shows)

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Solid color panels, slightly staggered, sweep across and cover the frame, then sweep off the far side and reveal the incoming image

transitions.name: ColorPhase

fromStep.description: When each channel (r, g, b, a) starts changing

toStep.description: When each channel (r, g, b, a) finishes changing

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A crossfade in which each color channel changes at a different time

transitions.name: ColorWrap

r_strength.description: Shift of the red channel over the transition

g_strength.description: Shift of the green channel over the transition

b_strength.description: Shift of the blue channel over the transition

transitions.author: Yoni Maltsman @friendlyspinach
transitions.description: Each color channel of the outgoing image is shifted and wraps around into psychedelic bands, while crossfading to the incoming image

transitions.name: Comb

vertical.description: Cut the frame into columns that slide up and down instead

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The frame is cut into interleaved strips that slide in opposite directions, each pushing the outgoing image out and the incoming one in

transitions.name: ComicPanels

gutter.description: Width of the gutters between the panels, as a part of the frame's height

gutterColor.description: Color of the gutters and of the page's margin

borderColor.description: Color of the ink borders around the panels

seed.description: Changes the layout of the panels

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The frame splits into slanted comic-book panels with gutters and ink borders; one after another in reading order, each panel lifts off the page with a zoom kick and a drop shadow and punches over to the incoming image, then the gutters close up over the full incoming image

transitions.name: CrazyParametricFun
transitions.author: mandubian
transitions.description: The outgoing image is pulled along a parametric curve into a psychedelic swirl

transitions.name: CrossWarp
transitions.author: Eke Péter <peterekepeter@gmail.com>
transitions.description: The outgoing image zooms in while the incoming one zooms out into place, sweeping from right to left

transitions.name: CrossZoom
transitions.author: rectalogic
transitions.description: A crossfade through a strong zoom blur

transitions.name: Crosshatch
transitions.author: pthrasher
transitions.description: The incoming image appears through a crosshatch of lines spreading from the center

transitions.name: Crumple

creases.description: Number of folds creasing the paper

size.description: Radius of the paper ball, relative to the image height

direction.description: Direction the ball is tossed toward

paper.description: Color of the bare paper showing through the ink along the sharpest creases

shadow.description: Color of the shadow cast on the incoming image

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image crumples into a creased paper ball, shaded along its folds, which is then tossed away to reveal the incoming image

transitions.name: Cube

unzoom.description: How far the camera pulls back mid-turn, as a part of the frame

floating.description: Gap between the box and its reflection, as a percentage of the frame height

shading.description: How much the faces darken as they turn away, and the shadow on the floor

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The two images are faces of a box that turns a quarter turn in perspective, the outgoing face darkening as it turns away, above a reflective floor

transitions.name: CurtainRise

swags.description: Number of swags across a 16:9 frame (fewer in a portrait image)

sag.description: How low each swag droops between two cords, as a part of the frame's height

ruffles.description: Number of gathered ruffles in the fabric

shading.description: Depth of the shading on the ruffles and swags, and of the shadow under the hem

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image rises like a theater festoon curtain: cords lift its hem into scalloped swags while the fabric gathers into shaded ruffles, and it is drawn up out of the frame over the incoming image

transitions.name: Curtains

folds.description: Number of folds in each curtain (fewer in a portrait image)

shading.description: Depth of the shading on the folds

bunch.description: Width of each curtain once gathered, relative to the image width

sway.description: How much the bottom of the curtains lags behind the top

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image parts in the middle like stage curtains, gathering into shaded folds as it is pulled to the sides

transitions.name: CurvedWipe

direction.description: Direction the edge moves toward

curvature.description: How far the middle of the edge leads its sides

shadow.description: Color of the soft shadow the lifted edge casts on the incoming image (its alpha is its strength; 0 for none)

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image is pulled away by its middle: the wipe edge bulges into a smooth curve that leads the way, then flattens as it reaches the far side

transitions.name: CylinderRoll

curvature.description: How much the frame wraps around the drum

blur.description: Length of the motion blur at full speed

shading.description: How much the drum darkens as it turns away

chroma.description: Amount of RGB split along the roll, growing with speed

downward.description: Roll downward instead, the incoming image coming around from above

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The frame wraps around a drum that rolls up, the outgoing image turning away over its top in a motion blur and the incoming one coming around from below and unrolling flat

transitions.name: DefocusBlur
transitions.author: Sergey Kosarevsky
transitions.description: A crossfade through an out-of-focus blur

transitions.name: DiamondWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A soft-edged diamond grows from the center to reveal the incoming image

transitions.name: Directional

direction.description: Direction of the movement

transitions.author: Gaëtan Renaudeau
transitions.description: The incoming image pushes the outgoing one out in a given direction

transitions.name: DirectionalEased

direction.description: Direction of the movement

transitions.author: Max Plotnikov
transitions.description: Like Directional, with an eased movement

transitions.name: DirectionalScaled

direction.description: Direction of the movement

transitions.author: Thibaut Foussard
transitions.description: Like Directional, with both images scaled down while they slide

transitions.name: DirectionalWarp

direction.description: Direction of the wipe

transitions.author: pschroen
transitions.description: A diagonal wipe with a warped, smeared edge

transitions.name: DirectionalWipe

direction.description: Direction of the wipe

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A straight wipe in any direction, diagonal and soft-edged by default; a smoothness of 0 gives a hard edge

transitions.name: Disintegrate

particleSize.description: Size of the dust grains, in frame heights

direction.description: Direction in which the wind blows the dust

spread.description: How far the dust flies and scatters before it fades out

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image crumbles into fine dust from one side, its grains blown away by the wind and fading out, revealing the incoming image underneath

transitions.name: DisplacementMap
transitions.author: Travis Fischer
transitions.description: A crossfade in which a displacement map (an extra grayscale texture) warps both images

transitions.name: DitherDissolve

dotSize.description: Size of a dither dot, relative to the height

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The incoming image appears through a regular 8x8 ordered dither pattern, like a retro computer screen

transitions.name: DominoFall

reverse.description: The chain runs from right to left instead of left to right

knock.description: Part of a slat's fall after which it knocks the next one: lower runs the chain faster, with more slats falling at once

lean.description: How far each slat's top leans sideways onto the next one, as a part of a slat's width

shading.description: How much the slats darken as they fall, and the shadows they cast

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image is cut into standing slats that topple backward like dominoes in a chain reaction across the frame, each one leaning onto the next and knocking it over, until they all lie flat and reveal the incoming image

transitions.name: DoomMelt
transitions.author: Zeh Fernando
transitions.description: The outgoing image melts down in uneven columns, like the Doom screen wipe

transitions.name: Doorway

reflection.description: Strength of the floor reflection under the incoming image

perspective.description: Amount of perspective on the swinging doors

depth.description: How far back the incoming image starts (1: no distance)

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image opens like double doors swinging toward the viewer, as the incoming one comes forward from the dark room behind, with a floor reflection

transitions.name: Drape

folds.description: Number of folds across the cloth (fewer in a portrait image)

depth.description: Depth of the folds and of their shading

sway.description: How much the cloth sways sideways as it falls

shadow.description: Strength of the soft shadow cast by the cloth on the incoming image

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image hangs like a sheet of fabric that is let go at the top: it collapses into soft, uneven folds that hide one another as the cloth bunches up and slides down out of the frame, revealing the incoming image behind it

transitions.name: Dreamy
transitions.author: mikolalysenko
transitions.description: A crossfade with a gentle wavy distortion

transitions.name: DreamyZoom
transitions.author: Zeh Fernando
transitions.description: Zooms and rotates into a bright flash, then out to the incoming image

transitions.name: DuotoneFade

shadowInk.description: Ink printed in the shadows (its alpha is its strength)

highlightInk.description: Ink printed in the highlights (its alpha is its strength)

contrast.description: How hard the tones are pushed apart toward the two inks

grain.description: Amount of print grain in the inks and along the handoff

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image is printed in two inks, shadows first, as a bold high-contrast duotone; the incoming image is printed over it in the same two inks, its dark tones landing before its highlights, then its own colors come back, highlights first

transitions.name: EdgeGlow
transitions.author: Woohyun Kim
transitions.description: Both images fade through black with their edges glowing

transitions.name: EyeBlink

blur.description: How much the image blurs and dims while the eyes are closed

softness.description: Width of the soft shadow along the rim of the eyelids

blinks.description: Number of blinks: 1, or 2 for a quick double blink (the cut happens on the first one)

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Curved eyelids close from the top and bottom over the outgoing image, which blurs and dims, then open on the incoming image as it comes back into focus, as if the viewer blinked

transitions.name: FacetedGlass

facets.description: Number of facets across the height of the frame

refraction.description: How far each facet shifts its view of the image at the peak

bevel.description: Strength of the highlights and shadows along the beveled edges, and of the glint as each facet turns

highlight.description: Color of the light caught by the bevels

seed.description: Random seed: another value gives other facets, turning in another order

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The frame is seen through a pane of irregular cut-glass facets, each one showing its own shifted, zoomed and tilted view of the image, with bright beveled edges and thin dark seams; the facets turn to the incoming image one by one, then the glass flattens out and clears

transitions.name: Fade
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A linear crossfade between the two images

transitions.name: FadeColor

colorPhase.description: How long the color shows in the middle

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A fade through a solid color, black by default

transitions.name: FadeGrayscale

intensity.description: How long the grayscale phase lasts

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A crossfade through grayscale

transitions.name: FallOver

shading.description: How much the image darkens as it falls

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image falls over backward, hinged on its bottom edge, revealing the incoming one behind it

transitions.name: FilmBurn
transitions.author: Anastasia Dunbar
transitions.description: Glowing film-burn light leaks wash over the image and reveal the incoming one

transitions.name: FilmDissolve

overlap.description: Extra light where the two images overlap at mid-dissolve, softly rolled off so it never clips

smoothness.description: Easing of the dissolve: 0 is linear, 1 eases in and out

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A cross-dissolve blended in linear light, as light adds up on film: the frame keeps its brightness all the way through and the highlights of each image shine through the other

transitions.name: FilmStrip

frames.description: Number of frames that slip by

shrink.description: How much the picture shrinks during the slip, showing the film's edges

blur.description: Length of the motion blur at full speed

weave.description: Amount of horizontal weave and vertical jitter

filmColor.description: Color of the film around the pictures and of the line between frames

holeColor.description: Color of the light through the sprocket holes

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The picture slips like film in a projector gate: it shrinks to show the sprocket holes, the strip runs down with motion blur and a slight weave, then the incoming frame lands in place

transitions.name: Fisheye

strength.description: Strength of the lens at its peak

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image bulges toward the viewer through a strong fisheye lens, then the incoming one flattens back into place

transitions.name: FlameWipe

direction.description: Direction in which the flames sweep across the frame

height.description: Height of the flames, as a fraction of the frame height

scorch.description: How much the outgoing image browns and chars ahead of the flames

glow.description: Strength of the warm glow left on the incoming image

color.description: Tint of the body of the flames

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A wall of flames sweeps across the frame, scorching the outgoing image ahead of it and leaving the incoming image under a fading warm glow

transitions.name: FlashFade
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A crossfade that brightens toward a color in the middle

transitions.name: FlowerWipe
transitions.author: Fernando Kuteken
transitions.description: A flower shape with several petals grows to reveal the incoming image

transitions.name: FlyEye
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The image breaks into a fly's-eye grid of lenses with color separation

transitions.name: Fold
transitions.author: nwoeanhinnogaehr
transitions.description: The incoming image unfolds from the left while the outgoing one folds away to the right

transitions.name: FrostWipe

spread.description: How far the crystal fingers reach ahead of the frost

scale.description: Size of the crystals: more, smaller ones with a larger value

blur.description: How much the frost blurs the image under it

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Ice crystals grow in from the edges of the frame with feathery, branching fronts, frosting the outgoing image white and blurry until it is covered, then thaw back out to the edges on the incoming image

transitions.name: Funnel

target.description: Point of the bottom edge where the image disappears, from left (0) to right (1)

curvature.description: Shape of the funnel's sides: 0 straight, 1 bent into an S curve

shadow.description: Strength of the shading of the bent image and of the shadow it casts

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image narrows into a curved funnel toward a point on the bottom edge and slides into it, its sides bending like a window minimized into a dock, revealing the incoming image behind it

transitions.name: Gallery

direction.description: Way the row moves: 1 brings the incoming slide in from the right, -1 from the left

tilt.description: How much the slides turn as they leave the center

gap.description: Space between two slides, in slide widths

zoom.description: How far the camera pulls back

reflection.description: Strength of the reflection of the slides on the floor

background.description: Color of the wall and the floor around the slides

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The camera pulls back from the outgoing image to show it as a slide hanging in a row on a wall in perspective, the row glides along as each slide turns away from the center, and the camera moves back in on the incoming slide until it fills the frame

transitions.name: GlintDissolve

size.description: Length of the longest rays of the glints at the peak, in frame heights

threshold.description: Brightness above which the image sparkles

diagonals.description: Add a shorter, softer pair of diagonal rays to each glint

rotation.description: Angle of the cross, in degrees

tint.description: Tint of the glints, added as light

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The bright points of the outgoing image sparkle into crisp four-point star glints that swell and twinkle up to the cut, then shrink back into the highlights of the incoming image, which stays sharp

transitions.name: GlitchBands
transitions.author: Yoni Maltsman @friendlyspinach
transitions.description: A crossfade with glitchy horizontal bands and color shifts

transitions.name: GlitchDisplace
transitions.author: Matt DesLauriers
transitions.description: Blocks of the image are displaced in a glitch that flashes into the incoming image

transitions.name: GlitchFlicker
transitions.author: bread
transitions.description: A flickering glitch with RGB offset, ghosting and scanlines that flashes back to the outgoing image

transitions.name: GlitchMemories
transitions.author: Gunnar Roth
transitions.description: A crossfade with glitchy, color-shifted blocks

transitions.name: GlitterDissolve

tiles.description: Number of tiles stacked across the height of the frame

sparkle.description: Strength of the glints the tiles catch as they turn

glint.description: Color of the glints, added as light

seed.description: Changes the order and the axes of the flips (whole numbers)

backColor.description: Color seen behind a tile while it is edge-on

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The image becomes a shimmering field of tiny diamond sequins that flip over in 3D at random moments, each lifting and tilting on its own axis and flashing a glint of light, and land on the incoming image

transitions.name: GlowDissolve

uHotClr.description: Color of the hottest part of the edge

transitions.author: hjm1fb
transitions.description: The incoming image spreads over the outgoing one with a hot, glowing edge

transitions.name: GooeyWipe

blobs.description: Number of blobs across the frame

smoothness.description: How smoothly neighbouring blobs melt into each other

highlight.description: Color of the glossy highlight on the rim of the blobs (its alpha is its strength)

shadow.description: Color of the soft shadow that the blobs cast on the outgoing image

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Soft, glossy blobs of liquid pop up over the outgoing image, swell and melt into each other, revealing the incoming image until they cover the whole frame

transitions.name: GravityLens

strength.description: How strongly the light bends: radius of the lensed ring beyond the disk's edge, in disk radii

glow.description: Brightness of the lensed ring and of the thin ring of light hugging the disk's edge

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A black disk appears and grows, bending the outgoing image around it like a heavy mass bends light: the image is stretched into a bright ring at the disk's edge and swallowed until the frame is black, then the disk shrinks back, unbending the incoming image

transitions.name: GridFlip

pause.description: Part of the transition at the start and at the end during which the gaps between the tiles open and close

dividerWidth.description: Width of the gaps between the tiles, as a part of a tile's shorter side

randomness.description: How much the order of the flips is shuffled, from a diagonal wave across the grid to random

transitions.author: TimDonselaar
transitions.description: The image splits into a grid of cards that lift apart and turn over in perspective one after another, each one showing its part of the incoming image on its back

transitions.name: Halftone

dots.description: Number of dots across the shorter side

angle.description: Angle of the dot grid, in degrees

paper.description: Color of the paper between the dots

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The image breaks into printed halftone dots whose size follows its shades, the dots reshape into the incoming image, then merge back into it

transitions.name: HeartWipe

pulse.description: Strength of the heartbeat throb as the heart grows

glowColor.description: Color of the soft light glowing along the heart's edge

glow.description: Strength of the glow (0 for a clean edge)

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A heart grows from the center with a little heartbeat to reveal the incoming image

transitions.name: HeatHaze

strength.description: How far the haze bends the image, in frame heights (the strongest waves bend it about 1.5 times as far)

scale.description: Size of the heat waves: more, smaller ones with a larger value

speed.description: How fast the heat waves rise

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Shimmering heat waves rise through the frame, strongest at the bottom, making the outgoing image wobble like the air over hot asphalt; the incoming image shows through the haze and settles as it calms

transitions.name: Hexagonalize
transitions.author: Fernando Kuteken
transitions.description: Both images turn into hexagons, crossfade, then sharpen again

transitions.name: Hologram

background.description: Color behind the hologram, seen between its scanlines and where it breaks up

scanlines.description: Number of scanlines over the frame height

jitter.description: How far rows of the hologram jump sideways, relative to the frame width

flicker.description: Strength of the flicker and of the rows that drop out

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image turns into a flickering hologram (blue by default) with scanlines and jittering rows, breaks up, and the hologram resolves into the incoming image in full color

transitions.name: Honeycomb

size.description: Number of hexagons across the shorter side

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The image splits into hexagons that spin and shrink away in a wave from the center, uncovering the incoming image

transitions.name: HorizontalClose
transitions.author: martiniti
transitions.description: The incoming image closes in from the top and bottom edges toward the middle

transitions.name: HorizontalOpen
transitions.author: martiniti
transitions.description: The incoming image opens from a line in the middle toward the top and bottom edges

transitions.name: HsvFade
transitions.author: nwoeanhinnogaehr
transitions.description: A crossfade through the HSV color space that cycles through hues

transitions.name: InkBleed

tendrils.description: How far the curling tendrils reach out of the blooms

rim.description: How dark the rim of ink at the front of the blooms is

seed.description: Random seed for the drop positions and the swirls

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The incoming image spreads over the outgoing one like drops of ink in water, blooming from a few points with curling, wispy edges and a darker rim, until it fills the frame

transitions.name: InsetWipe

anchor.description: Where the rectangle grows from: (0, 0) bottom left, (1, 1) top right, (0.5, 0) middle of the bottom edge, (0.5, 0.5) center

borderWidth.description: Width of a border drawn around the rectangle, in frame heights (0: no border)

reverse.description: The outgoing image shrinks into the rectangle instead, toward the anchor

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A rectangle anchored in a corner, on an edge or in the center grows until the incoming image fills the frame, revealing it in place without scaling it; in reverse, the outgoing image shrinks into the rectangle

transitions.name: InsideCube

direction.description: Direction the view turns toward, snapped to its main axis (left, right, up or down): the incoming image is on the wall on that side

fov.description: Field of view along the turn, in degrees: at 90 the camera stays at the center of the cube, a wider view makes the walls recede more

shading.description: How much the walls darken as they turn away, and the shadow in the inner corners of the cube

background.description: Color of the other faces of the cube, seen where the two walls leave the frame uncovered during the turn

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The camera stands inside a cube: the outgoing image covers the wall in front of it and the view turns toward the next inner wall, so the outgoing image swings away in perspective as the incoming one turns into view, the walls darkening into the shaded inner corner between them

transitions.name: InvertedPageCurl
transitions.author: Hewlett-Packard
transitions.description: The outgoing image curls away like a page, revealing the incoming one

transitions.name: Kaleidoscope
transitions.author: nwoeanhinnogaehr
transitions.description: A crossfade through a spinning kaleidoscope

transitions.name: KeyholeWipe

rim.description: Strength of the bevelled rim around the keyhole and the shadow inside it (0 for a clean cut)

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A keyhole grows steadily from the center until the incoming image fills the frame, its bevelled rim and inner shadow making it read as a hole cut in a plate

transitions.name: LeafWipe
transitions.author: @Flexi23
transitions.description: A leaf shape grows from the center to reveal the incoming image

transitions.name: LedWall

cells.description: Number of diodes across the shorter side

glow.description: Strength of the glow bleeding from the diodes into the dark panel

flash.description: Brightness of the flash of each diode as it switches

zoom.description: How much the picture zooms in while it is a screen

triads.description: Each diode is made of red, green and blue sub-diodes

direction.description: Direction in which the refresh wave sweeps across the screen

panel.description: Color of the panel between the diodes

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The picture zooms into a giant LED screen of round glowing diodes on a dark panel; a refresh wave sweeps across it, each diode flicking with a bright pop as it switches to the incoming image, then the diodes melt back into the plain picture

transitions.name: LeftRight
transitions.author: zhmy
transitions.description: The outgoing image shrinks away to the left while the incoming one slides in from the right

transitions.name: LensFlare

angle.description: Angle of the path of the light, in degrees (0 sweeps from left to right)

height.description: How far above the center of the frame the light passes

color.description: Color of the streak and of the glare

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A bright light sweeps across the frame and flares the lens: a long thin horizontal streak, a glowing core and a trail of colored ghost reflections; at its peak the incoming image spreads out from the light under its glare

transitions.name: LightRays

center.description: Point the rays stream away from, at the middle of the transition

drift.description: How far the center drifts during the transition, from left to right

reach.description: Length of the rays at the peak, as a fraction of their distance to the center

threshold.description: Brightness above which the image casts rays

tint.description: Tint of the rays, toward their ends

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Shafts of light burst from the highlights of the outgoing image and stream outward from a slowly drifting center; at their peak the incoming image takes over and its own rays shrink back into its highlights

transitions.name: LightStreaks

reach.description: Length of the streaks at the peak, in frame widths

threshold.description: Brightness above which the image flares

tint.description: Tint of the streaks, toward their ends

blur.description: Length of the motion blur at the peak

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The highlights of the outgoing image flare into long horizontal (or vertical) lens streaks while it smears with motion blur; at the peak the incoming image takes over and its streaks shrink back into its highlights as it sharpens

transitions.name: LightWipe

direction.description: Direction the band of light moves toward

width.description: Width of the bright core of the band, in frame heights

color.description: Tint of the light, toward the edges of the band (its core burns white)

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A band of intense light sweeps across the frame like a glint on glass, blooming the highlights of both images, and leaves the incoming image behind it

transitions.name: LightningFlash

bolts.description: Number of bolts: the main one strikes the ground, the others fork out higher in the sky

strike.description: Where the main bolt strikes, from the left (0) to the right (1) of the frame

seed.description: Changes the shape of the bolts

color.description: Color of the light, added to the images

glow.description: Size and brightness of the glow around the bolts

flashes.description: Number of strobes; the images switch during the brightest one

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Forked lightning bolts crack down from the top of the frame, the screen flashes white in a few stuttering strobes, and the incoming image appears lit by the last flickers as they fade out

transitions.name: LiquidFill

direction.description: Direction the liquid rises toward

amplitude.description: Height of the waves on the surface, in frame heights

waves.description: Number of waves across the frame

highlight.description: Color of the bright line along the surface and the rims of the bubbles (its alpha is its strength)

refraction.description: How much the incoming image is bent just below the surface

bubbles.description: How many bubbles rise through the liquid

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The incoming image rises over the outgoing one like liquid filling a glass, its surface sloshing in waves, lit by a bright meniscus line, bending the image just below it, with a few bubbles rising through it

transitions.name: LissajousTiles

speed.description: Speed of the tiles along their curves

freq.description: Number of loops of the curve, horizontally and vertically

offset.description: Extra vertical speed, which bends the curve

zoom.description: Size of the curve, relative to the image

fade.description: Spread of the tile-by-tile switch to the incoming image

transitions.author: Boundless <info@boundless-beta.com>
transitions.description: The image breaks into a grid of tiles that swirl along Lissajous curves, in a Scanimate style, and flip one by one to the incoming image before settling back

transitions.name: LumaWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A wipe that follows the brightness of a grayscale mask (the luma texture)

transitions.name: LuminanceMelt

direction.description: Direction of the melt (false: up, true: down)

above.description: Melt the parts above the threshold instead of below

transitions.author: 0gust1
transitions.description: The outgoing image melts away in noisy vertical streaks, depending on its brightness

transitions.name: MoireWipe

density.description: Number of rings per frame height in each set

bands.description: How many moire bands the rings make at the start; they get fewer and wider as the centers come together

drift.description: How far the two centers turn around each other, in turns

lines.description: Strength of the ring lines drawn over the image

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Two sets of fine concentric rings, centered on two points that drift toward each other, overlay the image and interfere into a shifting moire of wide bands; the bands open onto the incoming image and widen until it fills the frame, while the thin dark and light ring lines fade away

transitions.name: Morph
transitions.author: paniq
transitions.description: A crossfade in which each image is displaced by the other's colors, like a morph

transitions.name: Mosaic
transitions.author: Xaychru
transitions.description: The view pans across a mosaic of rotated tiles from both images and settles on the incoming one

transitions.name: MultiplyBlend
transitions.author: Fernando Kuteken
transitions.description: A crossfade through the multiplied blend of both images

transitions.name: NoiseDissolve
transitions.author: towrabbit
transitions.description: The incoming image appears pixel by pixel in random noise

transitions.name: Overexposure
transitions.author: Ben Zhang
transitions.description: A crossfade through a washed-out, overexposed white

transitions.name: PaperFold

direction.description: Direction the folded packet flies off toward

tilt.description: How much the sheet tilts and recedes while it folds, so that the folds are seen in 3D

shading.description: How much the faces darken as they turn away from the light, and the shadows they cast

paper.description: Color of the back of the paper, through which the print faintly shows

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image is a sheet of paper that folds in half in 3D along a vertical crease, then in half again along a horizontal one, its lit and shaded faces turning to show the back of the paper, and the small folded packet flies off the frame, leaving its shadow on the incoming image underneath

transitions.name: PaperTear

roughness.description: How far the tear wanders from the middle, relative to the image height

tilt.description: How much the top of each half leans away first, so that the tear opens from the top

rim.description: Width of the white torn edge, relative to the image height

paper.description: Color of the paper fibers on the torn edges

shadow.description: Color of the shadow cast on the incoming image

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image tears in two along a ragged line, and the halves are pulled apart to reveal the incoming one

transitions.name: PerlinDissolve

scale.description: Scale of the noise; higher values make smaller blobs

transitions.author: Rich Harris
transitions.description: The incoming image appears through blobs of Perlin noise

transitions.name: PhotoDevelop

card.description: Color of the blank card between the two images

wash.description: How long the outgoing image takes to wash out (from 10% to 70% of the transition)

tint.description: Strength of the cyan and magenta cast while the image develops

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image washes out to a blank cream card, then the incoming image develops on it like an instant photo: shadows first, faint and tinted, then its contrast and colors come up and it settles

transitions.name: Pinwheel
transitions.author: Mr Speaker
transitions.description: A spinning pinwheel reveals the incoming image

transitions.name: PixelStretch

direction.description: Direction in which the line sweeps

stretch.description: Length of the streaks at the middle of the sweep, as a part of the frame

chroma.description: Amount of RGB split along the streaks

softness.description: Softness of the line and of the streaks' ends, as a part of the frame

jitter.description: How much the streaks jitter, each row at its own length

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A line sweeps across the frame and drags the outgoing image's pixels behind it as long streaks, which shorten as it goes and reveal the incoming image

transitions.name: Pixelize

squaresMin.description: Number of squares at the strongest pixelation

steps.description: Number of pixelation steps; 0 for a continuous effect

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Both images pixelate, crossfade, then sharpen again

transitions.name: PlasmaDissolve

scale.description: Size of the plasma: higher values make more, thinner bands

flow.description: How much the plasma flows during the transition (at most 1, so a revealed area never goes back)

edgeColor.description: Color of the glow along the edges

edgeStrength.description: Strength of the glow along the edges

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A flowing plasma of sine waves, as in the old demos, draws moving bands through which the incoming image spreads like tendrils, with a glowing edge

transitions.name: PlusWipe

reverse.description: Close four corner rectangles in toward the middle instead

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A plus-shaped cross grows from the center and widens its arms until the incoming image fills the frame

transitions.name: PolkaDotsCurtain

dots.description: Number of dots across the image

transitions.author: bobylito
transitions.description: The incoming image appears through growing polka dots

transitions.name: PopIn

center.description: Point of the frame the incoming image pops from

bounce.description: How far the card overshoots (too big, then a bit small) before it settles

corner.description: Corner radius of the card while it pops, relative to its shorter side

shadow.description: Darkness of the drop shadow the card casts on the outgoing image

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The incoming image pops in as a rounded card over the outgoing one, with an elastic overshoot: too big, a bit small, then it settles into the full frame as its corners square off

transitions.name: PowerKaleido
transitions.author: Boundless
transitions.description: The image folds into an animated kaleidoscope before revealing the incoming one

transitions.name: Prisms

stagger.description: Delay of the last prism's turn, as a part of the transition

shading.description: How much the faces darken as they turn away

horizontal.description: Cut the frame into horizontal prisms instead

backColor.description: Color seen where the turning prisms leave the frame uncovered

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The frame is cut into 3D prisms that turn in a cascade, like a rotating billboard, from the outgoing image on one face to the incoming one on the next

transitions.name: Puzzle

pieces.description: Number of pieces across the shorter side

shadow.description: Darkness of the shadows of the lifted pieces

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The image is cut into jigsaw puzzle pieces that lift one after another and fall away, revealing the incoming image

transitions.name: PuzzleCube

size.description: Number of cubies along each side of the face

gap.description: Width of the gaps between the cubies, as a part of the frame's height

shading.description: How much the turning sides darken away from the light, and the shadows inside the cube

background.description: Color of the cubies' body, seen in the gaps, on their inner sides and around the cube

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The frame becomes the face of a twisty cube puzzle: dark gaps open between its cubies, then whole columns and rows of cubies turn a quarter turn around the cube one after another in 3D, each bringing the incoming image from the cube's side to the front, until the gaps close on the incoming image

transitions.name: RadialWipe
transitions.author: Xaychru
transitions.description: A radial wipe that sweeps around the center like a clock hand

transitions.name: RandomSquares
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The incoming image appears in random squares

transitions.name: RectangleCover
transitions.author: martiniti
transitions.description: A rectangle grows from the center to cover the outgoing image, then shrinks to reveal the incoming one

transitions.name: RectangleIris
transitions.author: martiniti
transitions.description: The outgoing image shrinks into a small rectangle over a background color, then the incoming one grows from it

transitions.name: Refraction

strength.description: How far the glass bends the image at the peak

scale.description: Size of the flowing waves: higher makes smaller waves

brightness.description: Brightness of the flare at the peak

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The frame is seen through flowing liquid glass that bends the outgoing image more and more, with rainbow fringes, flares up as the incoming image takes over, then calms down and clears

transitions.name: Revolve
transitions.author: bread
transitions.description: The outgoing image swirls and zooms with motion blur into the incoming one

transitions.name: RibbonTwist

spread.description: Length of the twisted section, as a part of the frame's width

perspective.description: Amount of perspective: the edge turning toward the viewer grows

shading.description: How much the ribbon darkens as it turns away

vertical.description: Twist around the vertical center line instead, travelling from top to bottom

backColor.description: Color seen where the twisting ribbon leaves the frame uncovered

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The image twists like a ribbon around its horizontal center line, the twist travelling smoothly across its width, the outgoing image on its front and the incoming one on its back

transitions.name: RingSpin

rings.description: Number of rings, from the center to the farthest corner

square.description: Square rings, like nested frames, instead of round ones

turns.description: Full turns made by each ring

stagger.description: Delay between the first ring and the last one, as a part of the transition

blur.description: Amount of angular motion blur while the rings spin fast

settle.description: Size of the overshoot when a ring locks

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The frame is cut into concentric rings that spin like the dials of a combination lock, in alternating directions and blurred with speed, one after another from the center outward; each ring overshoots a little and locks into place on the incoming image

transitions.name: RingsWipe

count.description: Number of rings, from the center to the farthest corner

center.description: Center of the rings, in texture coordinates

stagger.description: Delay between the starts of two rings: 0 moves them all together, 1 starts each one when the previous one is done

radial.description: Each ring fills across its width, outward and inward in turn, instead of sweeping around

borderWidth.description: Width of the borders between the rings while they move, in frame heights (0 disables them)

borderColor.description: Color of the borders between the rings

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Concentric rings ripple out from the center and, one after another, each sweeps around like a clock hand in the opposite direction of its neighbors to reveal the incoming image, or fills across its width, with optional colored borders between the rings

transitions.name: Ripple
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Ripples spread from the center while crossfading

transitions.name: Rolls

RotDown.description: Roll the outgoing image down instead of up

transitions.author: Mark Craig
transitions.description: The outgoing image rolls away around a corner, revealing the incoming one

transitions.name: RotateScaleFade
transitions.author: Fernando Kuteken
transitions.description: The outgoing image spins and zooms while fading to the incoming one, over a background color

transitions.name: RotateScaleVanish
transitions.author: Mark Craig
transitions.description: The outgoing image spins and shrinks away over the incoming one

transitions.name: SawtoothWipe

direction.description: Direction the toothed edge moves toward (with jaws, the axis along which the two edges part)

teeth.description: Number of teeth along the edge

depth.description: Length of the teeth, relative to their width

jaws.description: Two toothed edges part from the middle instead of one sweeping across

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A wipe whose edge is a row of sharp, regular triangular teeth sweeps across the frame, or two toothed edges that start interlocked part from the middle like jaws opening

transitions.name: Shatter

center.description: Impact point where the cracks start, from (0, 0) at the bottom left to (1, 1) at the top right

shards.description: Approximate number of rows of shards across the height of the frame

gravity.description: Strength of the gravity: the shards fall faster, and break loose over a longer time

seed.description: Random seed: another value gives other shards, tumbling another way

transitions.author: lbl
transitions.description: The outgoing image cracks like a pane of glass from an impact point, then its shards break loose from the impact outward, tumbling in 3D and falling away with gravity to reveal the incoming image behind

transitions.name: Shred

stagger.description: Spread of the strips' start times, as a part of the transition

tilt.description: Largest tilt of a falling strip, in radians

shadow.description: Darkness of the strips' cut edges and of their shadow

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image is cut into paper strips that drop away at uneven speeds, tilting as they fall, revealing the incoming image

transitions.name: SimpleFlip
transitions.author: nwoeanhinnogaehr
transitions.description: The outgoing image flips around the vertical axis into the incoming one

transitions.name: SimpleZoom

zoom_quickness.description: Part of the transition spent zooming

transitions.author: 0gust1
transitions.description: Zooms into the outgoing image, then fades to the incoming one

transitions.name: SimpleZoomOut

zoom_quickness.description: Part of the transition spent zooming

fade.description: Fade instead of cutting to the incoming image

transitions.author: Tianshuo
transitions.description: The incoming image zooms out into place while fading in

transitions.name: SketchDissolve

lineWidth.description: Thickness of the pencil outlines, in thousandths of the frame height

edges.description: How many outlines are drawn: higher also traces the fainter edges of the picture

hatching.description: Amount of diagonal hatching drawn in the shadows

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image fades back to blank paper while the incoming one is drawn on it in pencil, outlines first and then hatching in the shadows, before its shading and colors fill in until the picture is complete

transitions.name: SlideAwayRight
transitions.author: lizhongjian
transitions.description: The outgoing image slides to the right, uncovering a crossfade to the incoming one

transitions.name: Slides

In.description: Slide the incoming image in instead of the outgoing one out

transitions.author: Mark Craig
transitions.description: The outgoing image slides out, or the incoming one slides in, toward an edge, a corner or the center

transitions.name: SlotReels

blur.description: Amount of vertical motion blur while the reels spin fast

stagger.description: Delay between the first and the last reel's stop, as a part of the transition

bounce.description: Size of the bounce when a reel stops

separator.description: Color of the separators between the reels

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The frame is cut into vertical reels that spin downward like drums, motion-blurred with speed, carrying the outgoing image then the incoming one, and stop one after another from left to right with a small mechanical bounce

transitions.name: SmokeDissolve

direction.description: Direction the smoke drifts toward (it comes in from the opposite side); its length is how far it drifts, in frame heights

scale.description: Size of the billows: more, smaller ones with a larger value

spread.description: How much the smoke rolls in from one side rather than everywhere at once

softness.description: Softness of the smoke: wispier, more see-through edges with a larger value

color.description: Color of the smoke, lit from above

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Billowing smoke drifts in across the outgoing image, with lit tops, darker folds and wispy edges, and thickens until it covers the frame; as it thins out and drifts away, the incoming image shows through

transitions.name: SnakeBlockWipe

vertical.description: Wind down the columns instead of along the rows

smoothness.description: How long each block takes to fade in, in turns of one block (0 switches it at once)

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Blocks switch to the incoming image one at a time, row after row from the top (or column after column from the left), each line running the opposite way to the one before, like a snake winding across the frame

transitions.name: Snapshot

tilt.description: How much the photo turns as it drops

border.description: Width of the photo's border, relative to the frame height

shadow.description: Darkness of the soft shadow the photo casts on the incoming image

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A camera flash freezes the outgoing image into a printed photo with a white border, which shrinks, tilts and drops out of the frame, revealing the incoming image behind it

transitions.name: Sphere

direction.description: Direction the ball rolls away toward

size.description: Radius of the ball once wrapped, relative to the shorter side of the frame

shading.description: Strength of the light and shading on the ball

shadow.description: Darkness of the soft shadow the ball casts on the incoming image

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image wraps itself onto a shaded ball that shrinks and rolls away, revealing the incoming image under its shadow

transitions.name: SpiralBlockWipe

inward.description: Spiral from the top left corner inward; false spirals from the center outward, ending at the top left corner

smoothness.description: Duration of each block's fade, as a fraction of the transition

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Square blocks switch to the incoming image one after another along a rectangular spiral, from the border inward or from the center outward

transitions.name: SpiralWipe

turns.description: Number of turns of the spiral

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A spiral arm winds out from the center and widens to reveal the incoming image

transitions.name: SplatterWipe

splats.description: Number of splats across the frame

spikiness.description: How long the spikes around each splat are

droplets.description: How many droplets are flung around each splat

drips.description: How far the paint drips run down

rim.description: How dark and glossy the rim of the splats is

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Splats of paint land one after another, each popping in with a spiky outline, flung droplets and a few drips running down, revealing the incoming image until they cover the frame

transitions.name: SplitFlap

stagger.description: Delay of the last cell's flip, as a part of the transition

randomness.description: How much the order of the cells is shuffled, from a wave across the board to random

flaps.description: Number of flaps that fall in each cell, the ones before the last showing other parts of the incoming image

gap.description: Width of the gaps between the cells, as a part of the frame's shorter side (the hinges get half of it)

perspective.description: Amount of perspective: the falling flaps grow as they come toward the viewer

shading.description: How much the flaps darken as they turn away from the light, and the shadows they cast

background.description: Color seen in the gaps between the cells

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The frame becomes a split-flap board: in each cell the top half of the outgoing image flips down on a hinge across the middle, cell after cell, its back bringing the bottom half of the incoming image

transitions.name: SplitSlideInHorizontal

reverse.description: Swap the directions of the halves

transitions.author: OllyOllyOlly
transitions.description: The incoming image slides in as two halves moving horizontally in opposite directions

transitions.name: SplitSlideInOutHorizontal

reverse.description: Swap the directions of the halves

transitions.author: OllyOllyOlly
transitions.description: The halves of both images slide horizontally in opposite directions, out and in at once

transitions.name: SplitSlideInOutVertical

reverse.description: Swap the directions of the halves

transitions.author: OllyOllyOlly
transitions.description: The halves of both images slide vertically in opposite directions, out and in at once

transitions.name: SplitSlideInVertical

reverse.description: Swap the directions of the halves

transitions.author: OllyOllyOlly
transitions.description: The incoming image slides in as two halves moving vertically in opposite directions

transitions.name: SplitSlideOutHorizontal

reverse.description: Swap the directions of the halves

transitions.author: OllyOllyOlly
transitions.description: The outgoing image slides out as two halves moving horizontally in opposite directions

transitions.name: SplitSlideOutVertical

reverse.description: Swap the directions of the halves

transitions.author: OllyOllyOlly
transitions.description: The outgoing image slides out as two halves moving vertically in opposite directions

transitions.name: SpotlightWipe

center.description: Point where the spotlight comes to rest and opens from

size.description: Width of the spotlight while it searches, in frame heights

darkness.description: How dark the stage gets around the spotlight

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The stage lights go down on the outgoing image and a soft oval spotlight searches across it along a curved path, comes to rest and lights the incoming image inside it, then widens until the stage lights come back up on the incoming image

transitions.name: SquaresWipe

direction.description: Direction of the sweep

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Squares grow along a diagonal sweep to reveal the incoming image

transitions.name: Squeeze
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image is squeezed into a line with color separation, revealing the incoming one

transitions.name: StarWipe
transitions.author: Ben Lucas
transitions.description: A growing star reveals the incoming image

transitions.name: StaticFade
transitions.author: Ben Lucas
transitions.description: Cuts to the incoming image halfway, hidden behind a burst of TV static

transitions.name: StaticWipe

u_transitionUpToDown.description: Wipe from top to bottom; false wipes from bottom to top

u_max_static_span.description: Maximum height of the static band

transitions.author: Ben Lucas
transitions.description: A wipe from top to bottom with a band of TV static at its edge

transitions.name: StereoViewer

zoom.description: How much the images zoom out

transitions.author: Ted Schundler
transitions.description: Both images shrink into rounded cards that swap, like a stereo viewer toy

transitions.name: StretchSlide

direction.description: Direction in which the images slide

stretch.description: How long the outgoing image stretches and how much the squashed incoming one bulges

bounce.description: How far the incoming image overshoots before it springs back to its shape

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image stretches out long as it shoots away to one side, pulling in the incoming one squashed behind it, which overshoots and springs back to its shape

transitions.name: StripDatamoshGlitch
transitions.author: bread
transitions.description: A datamosh glitch: torn strips, chroma shifts and scan noise drag the outgoing image into the incoming one

transitions.name: Swap
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The two images swap places in 3D, with a floor reflection

transitions.name: Swirl

strength.description: Turns of the swirl at its center at the peak (negative turns clockwise)

radius.description: Radius of the swirl, in frame heights

transitions.author: Sergey Kosarevsky
transitions.description: The image twists into a round swirl around the center that peaks mid-way, where the outgoing image dissolves into the incoming one, then untwists

transitions.name: TangentMotionBlur
transitions.author: chenkai
transitions.description: The outgoing image is flung away along a curve with motion blur

transitions.name: TilesWave
transitions.author: numb3r23
transitions.description: The incoming image is revealed tile by tile in a diagonal wave

transitions.name: TopBottom
transitions.author: zhmy
transitions.description: The outgoing image shrinks away upward while the incoming one slides in from the bottom

transitions.name: TruchetWipe

cells.description: Number of tiles across the frame's height

outline.description: Strength of the dark outline and of the shadow along the bands

spread.description: How much the paths are staggered from the middle outward: 0 draws them all at once

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A grid of square tiles, each holding two quarter-circle arcs, links into long winding paths; starting from the middle and spreading outward, the paths are drawn as thin lines of the incoming image, then thicken into bands with a dark outline and a soft shadow until they merge over the whole frame

transitions.name: Tumble

flips.description: Number of turns end over end, negative to tumble the other way

spin.description: Turns of the secondary spin around the line of sight

direction.description: Where the card flies toward on screen, in frame heights from the center

shading.description: Shading of the card as it turns, darkness of its back and of its shadow

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image is thrown away like a rigid card, tumbling end over end with a slight spin as it flies off into the distance in perspective, its darker back showing on every flip and its soft shadow shrinking on the incoming image behind it

transitions.name: Tunnel

speed.description: How far and fast the camera flies down the tunnel

twist.description: How much the walls spiral as they rush by

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The camera flies down a tunnel lined with the outgoing image toward the incoming one, which opens at its far end and grows to fill the frame

transitions.name: TvLostSignal
transitions.author: mernking (gitlab.com/Godswork)
transitions.description: A crossfade with drifting tracking lines and tearing, like a TV losing its signal

transitions.name: TvRoll

rolls.description: Number of frames that roll by

barHeight.description: Height of the bar between the frames

barColor.description: Color of the bar between the frames

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image rolls faster and faster, like an old TV losing its vertical hold, then the roll slows down and locks on the incoming image

transitions.name: TvStatic

offset.description: Part of the transition, at each end, that shows the images instead of static

transitions.author: Brandon Anzaldi
transitions.description: Cuts to full-screen TV static, then to the incoming image

transitions.name: TvTurnOff

glow.description: Strength of the glow around the line and the dot

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image collapses into a glowing line and a dot, like an old TV turned off, then the incoming image powers on from the dot

transitions.name: UndulatingBurnOut
transitions.author: pthrasher
transitions.description: A circle with a wavy edge burns out from the center to reveal the incoming image

transitions.name: VerticalClose
transitions.author: martiniti
transitions.description: The incoming image closes in from the left and right edges toward the middle

transitions.name: VerticalOpen
transitions.author: martiniti
transitions.description: The incoming image opens from a line in the middle toward the left and right edges

transitions.name: VhsTracking

bands.description: Number of noise bands rolling down (the first one carries the cut)

noise.description: Amount of snow and tearing in the bands

bleed.description: How far the color smears to the right of the picture

wobble.description: How much the lines wobble sideways

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Tape-tracking bands of white snow roll down the frame, tearing the lines around them, with smeared color, wobbling lines, a jittering strip at the bottom and a dropout flash, as the incoming image is recorded over the outgoing one under the densest band

transitions.name: Vortex

spin.description: Turns each square makes around the center as it flies away (negative turns clockwise)

randomness.description: How randomly the squares leave: 0 from the center outward, 1 in any order

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image breaks into hundreds of small squares that a tornado carries away along a spiral around the center, from the eye outward, uncovering the incoming image

transitions.name: WarpSpeed

center.description: Point the camera flies toward, from (0, 0) at the bottom left to (1, 1) at the top right

streaks.description: Number of star streaks around the center

streakColor.description: Color of the streaks and of the flash, added as light

strength.description: Length of the streaks and of the radial smear

flash.description: Brightness of the flash at the peak of the jump

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The camera jumps to light speed: star streaks shoot out from the center and stretch longer and longer while the outgoing image is pulled into a radial smear, then after a flash the incoming image emerges from the center as the streaks shrink back

transitions.name: WaterDrop

amplitude.description: Frequency of the ripples: higher makes them closer together

speed.description: Speed of the ripples as they run outward through the spreading rings

center.description: Where the drop falls, in texture coordinates

refraction.description: How far the ripples bend the image, in frame heights

highlight.description: Brightness of the glints on the ripples

transitions.author: Paweł Płóciennik
transitions.description: A drop falls into the image like into still water: round ripples spread out from where it hits, bending the image with glints on their slopes, the incoming image shows up inside the leading ripple, and the water calms down

transitions.name: WaveWipe

direction.description: Direction the wave travels toward

curl.description: Size of the curling lip, in wave heights: how far it overhangs ahead of the face

foam.description: Amount of foam on the crest and spray thrown ahead of it

refraction.description: How much the water bends the incoming image behind the wave

water.description: Color of the water tinting the incoming image behind the wave (its alpha is its strength)

foamColor.description: Color of the foam and spray (its alpha is its strength)

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A breaking wave crashes across the frame, its lip curling over in front of its face and throwing foam and spray ahead, its shadow darkening the outgoing image; the incoming image is left behind it, tinted and bent by the water, clearing as the wave passes

transitions.name: WedgeWipe

angle.description: Direction the wedge opens from, in degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Two hands sweep away from each other around the center, opening a widening wedge that reveals the incoming image

transitions.name: WhipPan

direction.description: Direction in which the images move

blur.description: Length of the motion blur at full speed

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A fast camera pan that streaks both images with motion blur, the incoming one arriving from the opposite side

transitions.name: WhipSpin

turns.description: Total rotation, in turns, split between the two images (negative turns clockwise)

blur.description: Length of the motion blur along the spin

chroma.description: How much the color channels split apart as the spin speeds up

zoom.description: How much the camera zooms in at the fastest point

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The camera rolls faster and faster around the center of the frame, streaking the outgoing image in a spin blur, then the incoming one takes over mid-spin and slows to a stop

transitions.name: WhipTilt

down.description: Tilt the camera down to an incoming image below instead of above

blur.description: Length of the motion blur along the tilt

chroma.description: How much the color channels split apart as the tilt speeds up

perspective.description: Strength of the perspective (field of view of the camera)

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The camera tilts fast from the outgoing image to the incoming one, set edge to edge at an angle above it, streaking both in perspective with a vertical motion blur

transitions.name: Wind

reversed.description: Wipe from right to left instead

transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A ragged left-to-right wipe, as if the image was blown away by the wind

transitions.name: WindowBlinds
transitions.author: Fabien Benetou
transitions.description: A crossfade through horizontal window blinds

transitions.name: WindowSlices
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The incoming image appears through vertical slices that widen

transitions.name: ZoomInCircles
transitions.author: dycm8009
transitions.description: Concentric rings of the outgoing image zoom at different speeds before revealing the incoming one

transitions.name: ZoomInOut
transitions.author: OllyOllyOlly
transitions.description: Zooms into the outgoing image until it blurs into a flat color, then out to the incoming one

transitions.name: ZoomWipeLeft

zoom_quickness.description: Part of the first half spent zooming (capped at 0.5)

transitions.author: Handk
transitions.description: Zooms into the outgoing image, then the incoming one wipes in from right to left

transitions.name: ZoomWipeRight

zoom_quickness.description: Part of the first half spent zooming (capped at 0.5)

transitions.author: Handk
transitions.description: Zooms into the outgoing image, then the incoming one wipes in from left to right
